description: North Cyprus car rental (Kıbrıs araç kiralama): returns the rental cars actually available for a pickup/return window, with total prices (insurance and VAT included) in EUR and TRY, converted totals in the requested currency, and a prefilled booking URL. Data is live from the booking engine — never cached or invented.

currency.description: Optional display currency for converted totals (EUR and TRY are always included).

pickup_at.description: Pickup date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', Cyprus local time (Europe/Nicosia), within the booking hours.

return_at.description: Return date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', after pickup_at, within the booking hours.

name: check_car_availability
title: Check live car availability and prices
